entities.name: Luis Cardoza y Aragón
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luis Cardoza y Aragón was a Guatemalan writer, essayist, poet, art critic, and diplomat. Born in Antigua Guatemala, he spent part of his life living in exile in Mexico.
